summary: Issue #299 is fully implemented per the saved plan. ComposeManager.capture_companion_diagnostics (compose_manager.py) enumerates compose-project containers, captures per-unhealthy-companion tail logs, .State.Health.Log (ExitCode/Output), and the rendered healthcheck Test array, plus compose_project/compose_file/tail_lines/containers_inspected — best-effort (never raises) and fully redacted via redact_audit_value, with live log lines via redact_secrets. The provisioner's except ComposeOperationError handler captures diagnostics BEFORE _mark_failed/teardown, threads them into the persisted SERVICE_STARTUP_FAILURE WorkspaceEvent.payload via _mark_failed(event_payload=...)->repo.transition(payload=...), and re-raises the original COMPOSE_COMMAND_FAILED unchanged; a belt-and-suspenders guard records companion_logs_capture_error without masking the root error. The ServiceStartupDiagnosticsCapturer Protocol, optional service_diagnostics dependency, ProvisionerConfig.service_startup_log_tail_lines, and config plumbing (worker_service_startup_log_tail_lines default 200/gt=0 -> ServiceSettings -> worker wiring of compose as capturer) all match the plan. Tests cover every planned scenario: compose_manager_subprocess.py (happy path/unhealthy-only, secret-redaction regression, default tail, Id fallback, per-container + top-level + JSON-decode + malformed-entry error markers, no-containers, never-raises-on-docker-unavailable), provisioner_part_003.py (payload populated, capture-before-mark_failed ordering, capture-failure-does-not-mask-original COMPOSE_COMMAND_FAILED, payload-null-when-no-capturer, end-to-end real-capturer secret redaction), plus worker wiring and config default/env/validation/flow tests. plans/ISSUE_299_PLAN.md and plans/ISSUE_299_VALIDATION.md exist. Documented non-goals respected (no new reason codes, no new DB column, no API/OpenAPI/CLI/migration change, no profile-specific service names, deterministic teardown unchanged). The single deviation — adding a combine_stderr flag to the existing _docker_capture helper so stderr-only companions (postgres) are not captured empty — is documented in the plan and is consistent with the plan's intent (reuses the existing helper, no new abstraction).
